--!strict
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local TRANSPARENCY_PROPERTIES: { [string]: { string } } = {
	Frame = { "BackgroundTransparency" },
	ScrollingFrame = { "BackgroundTransparency", "ScrollBarImageTransparency" },
	TextLabel = { "BackgroundTransparency", "TextTransparency", "TextStrokeTransparency" },
	TextButton = { "BackgroundTransparency", "TextTransparency", "TextStrokeTransparency" },
	TextBox = { "BackgroundTransparency", "TextTransparency", "TextStrokeTransparency" },
	ImageLabel = { "BackgroundTransparency", "ImageTransparency" },
	ImageButton = { "BackgroundTransparency", "ImageTransparency" },
	UIStroke = { "Transparency" },
}

local DEFAULT_INFO = TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

local FadeIn = {}

-- Fades `root` and all its descendants from fully transparent to their current
-- (designed) transparency values. Returns the tweens so callers can cancel or await them.
function FadeIn.play(root: Instance, tweenInfo: TweenInfo?): { Tween }
	local info = tweenInfo or DEFAULT_INFO
	local tweens: { Tween } = {}

	local function fade(instance: Instance)
		local properties = TRANSPARENCY_PROPERTIES[instance.ClassName]
		if not properties then
			return
		end

		local goals = {}
		for _, property in properties do
			goals[property] = (instance :: any)[property]
			;(instance :: any)[property] = 1
		end
		table.insert(tweens, TweenService:Create(instance, info, goals))
	end

	fade(root)
	for _, descendant in root:GetDescendants() do
		fade(descendant)
	end

	-- Make visible only after everything is hidden, so there is no one-frame flash.
	if root:IsA("ScreenGui") then
		root.Enabled = true
	elseif root:IsA("GuiObject") then
		root.Visible = true
	end

	for _, tween in tweens do
		tween:Play()
	end

	return tweens
end

return FadeIn
